## BLOX Platform Overview

BLOX (weareblox.com) is a Dutch cryptocurrency exchange registered with De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) as a provider of crypto services. It is designed as a user-friendly broker that buys and sells crypto directly to users against a fixed price. Key facts:

- **Listed coins:** 72+ cryptocurrencies available
- **Minimum investment:** Starting from 1 EUR
- **Earn program ("BLOX Verdien"):** Yields ranging from 0.25% to 5% annualized on select coins
- **Regulation:** Registered under Article 23b with DNB; compliant with strict AML/KYC regulations
- **Target market:** Netherlands and EU, particularly beginning investors

BLOX regularly adds new coins and allows users to vote for coins they want listed.
